why: The QVP is a named questionnaire and measurement instrument for evaluating virtual-patient usability and instructional integration, not a reusable instructional element.
name: Questionnaire Virtual Patient (QVP) instrument
product_description: The QVP is an 18-item-plus-background-questionnaire developed by Mårtensson et al. to assess nursing students' perceptions of virtual-patient user-friendliness and integration within intimate-partner-violence education.

why: QVP is a named questionnaire for assessing nursing students' acceptance and user experience of virtual-patient simulation, while TAM and UTAUT are merely its design foundations rather than a new learning theory.
name: QVP
product_description: QVP is a standardized questionnaire developed by the study team to measure undergraduate nursing students' perceptions, acceptance, and user experience of virtual-patient simulation.
